docs: TAO offers: a buyer deposits TAO to buy Alpha on a subnet at the market price
moved by their offset. TAO isn't tied to a subnet, so offers stay pooled here;
spot and lockup listings are vaults created by `lockup_listings`.
A seller fills an offer with `take_tao_offer`, which moves their stake straight
to the buyer through a proxy. Frontends add the proxy and remove it again in
the seller's own batch, so it never outlives the fill. Buyers can cancel at
any time, even while trading is paused.
TAO the seller received
args.label: tao_amount

docs: The owner proposed a new owner, or withdrew the proposal with `None`
events.label: OwnershipTransferProposed

docs: New offers and fills are paused until `until`
events.label: TradingPaused

docs: The position's TAO balance was sent to its owner
events.label: TaoSwept

docs: The position now points at the hotkey its stake moved to
events.label: HotkeyResynced

docs: The position installed new code
events.label: Upgraded

docs: The owner changed who may upgrade the position
events.label: UpgradePolicyChanged

docs: Deposit the transferred TAO as an offer to buy Alpha on `netuid` at the
market price moved by `price_offset_bps`.
`max_price` is the buyer's ceiling (TAO per Alpha, scaled by 1e9; 0 for
none): fills above it fail, which limits spot-price manipulation by a
seller who pushes the price up before filling.
messages.label: create_tao_offer

docs: Withdraw an offer and get the TAO back. Never paused.
messages.label: cancel_tao_offer

docs: Fill a whole offer: move the Alpha it buys at the current price from the
caller's stake on `hotkey` to the buyer, and receive the offer's TAO
minus the fee. Returns the Alpha moved.
The transfer goes through a proxy, so the caller must have added this
contract as a `Transfer` proxy; frontends add and remove it in the same
batch as this call. `max_alpha` is the seller's cap: the fill fails if
the price has fallen far enough to need more Alpha than that.
messages.label: take_tao_offer

docs: What filling an offer pays at the current market price. Sellers should
pass a `max_alpha` a little above `alpha`, since the price can move
before the fill lands.
messages.label: quote_offer_fill

docs: Propose `new_owner`, who takes over by calling `accept_ownership`. A new
proposal replaces the previous one; `None` withdraws it.
messages.label: transfer_ownership

docs: Set the fee rate for new offers, as U64F64 bits, at most `MAX_FEE_RATE`.
Open offers keep the rate they were created with.
messages.label: set_fee_rate

docs: Pause new offers and fills for `blocks` blocks, at most `MAX_PAUSE`.
Calling it again restarts the pause from now. Cancels are never paused.
messages.label: pause

docs: Install `code_hash`, which must be the registry's current otc code. Only
the owner can upgrade. The new code migrates storage on its next call,
or when anyone calls `migrate`.
messages.label: upgrade

docs: Bring storage up to this code's `STORAGE_VERSION`. Every state-changing
message does this first; anyone can also call it directly after an
upgrade.
messages.label: migrate
